summary: When a parts lookup involves filters, plugs, belts, sensors, commercial-vehicle service parts, or cross references, check data/offline_parts_catalogs/catalog_index.json if present and search data/offline_parts_catalogs/text with rg.
required_action: Use local extracted text as supporting evidence after VIN/EPC or exact vehicle profile is established.
safety: Do not promote aftermarket catalog matches into OEM candidates.

summary: CRM notes may cite offline catalog evidence by publisher, title, catalog_id, source URL, retrieved date, and checked number.
required_action: Keep notes compact and avoid catalog table dumps.
safety: Do not store raw VIN/client data or long catalog excerpts in durable memory or CRM summaries.

summary: No public legal offline MAN EPC cache is part of this pack; MAN OEM part numbers require authorized webMANTIS/PartsBase/partslink24/dealer/supplier evidence.
required_action: If only third-party MANTIS installers or mirrors are available, mark OEM lookup blocked until authorized evidence is obtained.
safety: No third-party EPC dumps, cracked installers, torrents, or forum mirrors.
